scope: Read-only CPU evidence review; no MLX imports, GPU execution, model loading, or service operations.

checks.name: actual counts and export integrity
checks.detail: Recomputed coverage from private token arrays; regenerated each public export exactly; raw and public hashes match. Fixed ten-control assertion is an expected protocol shape, not fabricated coverage.

checks.name: all runs and selection
checks.detail: All 24 full-allocation candidates retained; independent minimum reproduces frozen depth-three batched/dense-trim/bucket choice. Native batch is reported and faster; not eligible as internal optimization choice. No heldout execution route in harness.

checks.name: numerical failures
checks.detail: 0/120 strict 1e-5 allclose checks retained, including legacy controls; 120 argmax/offset checks pass. accepted=false and performance_claim=false in every report.

checks.name: historical sources and privacy
checks.detail: Frozen v1 harness/report/workload identical to HEAD; all three v2 source maps match private snapshot. Reviewed public scope contains no raw prompt/token arrays or private absolute user paths.

checks.name: baseline and measurement scope
checks.detail: Native BatchGenerator batch-two simultaneous requests and fixed output budgets retained. Ignored EOS, minimal warm-up, first-use compilation and distinct-depth single observations explicitly disclosed; no mature-engine superiority claimed.

checks.name: final export metadata and error redaction
checks.detail: Final CPU-only exporter refresh preserves measured raw bytes, includes resident load/warmup/input counts; synthetic failure with private path and prompt exports only exception type plus hashed detail.

limits: Private workload hashes do not provide standalone public corpus reproducibility.
Prospective protocol intent is documented; filesystem review alone cannot independently certify wall-clock creation chronology.
Single observations with fixed control order and minimal batch warm-up cannot support performance significance.
Exporter trusts observed summary fields; review recomputed actual frozen artifacts independently. Future malformed or failed reports require separate validation.
